description: Zero-config search for AI agents: Baidu, Yahoo! JAPAN, Bing, Naver, Yahoo (US), Yandex, AliExpress, Goofish, Mercari, Yahoo Auctions, Yahoo Flea Market, Rakuma, Rakuten Ichiba, Qoo10, Yahoo! Shopping, Amazon, YouTube, Bilibili and CSDN in one MCP server. No API key, no login, no configuration.
long_description:
ZeroSearch gives an AI agent nineteen search providers behind one MCP server, in four categories: web search (Baidu, Yahoo! JAPAN, Bing, Naver, Yahoo US, Yandex), shopping search (AliExpress, Goofish, Mercari, Yahoo! Auctions, Yahoo! Flea Market, Rakuma, Rakuten Ichiba, Qoo10, Yahoo! Shopping, Amazon), media platforms (YouTube, Bilibili) and article platforms (CSDN).

There is nothing to configure: no API key, no account, no environment variables. Register the server binary in the MCP config and its tools work — with one exception: Goofish's signing runtime embeds the Goofish APK and cannot be redistributed, so Goofish needs a one-time runtime assembly (see runtime/goofish in the repository). Each provider reuses the app-faithful access patterns established for the standalone servers (which this project merges and replaces), and tool names, arguments and result JSON are unchanged from those servers.

The same code is available as the Rust library `zero_search`: a unified API (per-engine search, all-engine search with per-engine outcomes, category-wide search, product search) designed to be embedded as an agent harness's default search tool, with every provider crate re-exported for full access.
name: zero-search-mcp

tools.description: Search Baidu through the APK-derived (baiduboxapp) anonymous search flow and return the aggregated multi-page result JSON (same shape as the Python baidu_search client, plus provider/ok). Per-page failures are recorded in diagnostics.errors and already-fetched pages are kept.
tools.name: baidu_search

tools.description: Fetch and parse exactly one Baidu search-result page. With page_url omitted the first-page URL is built from query; otherwise page_url is fetched as-is (server-issued pagination URL). The optional page (1-based) builds the URL for that page instead (pn offset), taking precedence over page_url. Failures return {provider, ok:false, error:{kind,message,url,status_code}} with the Python client's error kind.
tools.name: baidu_search_page

tools.description: Fetch Baidu search suggestions from the app's three suggestion systems: classic (the classic sug endpoint — on current server behaviour this returns an HTTP error, recorded per-system), recommendations (SugRec related/guess words) and inputbox (the AI input box: chat suggestions and content groups). With system omitted all three are queried and per-system failures are recorded in the systems field instead of failing the call.
tools.name: baidu_suggest

tools.description: Parse a saved Baidu (APK/wise) search-result HTML page into structured JSON, offline (no network). Returns the Python baidu_parser page dict plus provider/ok.
tools.name: baidu_parse_search_results

tools.description: Build the first-page Baidu search URL for a query (APK bq0.m reproduction: pu merges, https upgrade, ant_ct, t_samp). now_ms pins the clock for reproducibility; omit for the current time.
tools.name: baidu_build_search_url

tools.description: List the search providers and tools supported by Baidu_MCP.
tools.name: baidu_list_sources

tools.description: Search the Yahoo! JAPAN web index. Best general-purpose tool for finding Japanese web pages, shops, official sites and documentation. Returns title, URL, snippet and the source site, plus related queries Yahoo suggests. 10 results per page.
tools.name: yahoo_web_search

tools.description: Search Yahoo! JAPAN images. Returns the source page, the original image URL, a Yahoo-cached copy that stays reachable when the origin blocks hotlinking, a thumbnail and pixel dimensions. 20 results per page.
tools.name: yahoo_image_search

tools.description: Search Yahoo! JAPAN videos across YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Niconico and other hosts. Returns title, watch URL, uploader, duration, upload date and a summary. 20 results per page.
tools.name: yahoo_video_search

tools.description: Search Yahoo!ニュース for Japanese news articles. Returns headline, article URL, publisher, publish time, category and a snippet. Use this over web search for current events in Japan. Yahoo returns one batch of up to 60 articles and does not paginate.
tools.name: yahoo_news_search

tools.description: Search Yahoo!リアルタイム検索 for X (Twitter) posts. Best for what people in Japan are saying right now — breaking incidents, service outages, live reactions. Returns post text, author, timestamp and engagement counts. 40 results per page.
tools.name: yahoo_realtime_search

tools.description: Search Yahoo!知恵袋, Japan's largest community Q&A site. Best for real-world Japanese consumer questions, troubleshooting and local know-how that rarely appears on formal sites. Returns question title, URL, status, answer/view counts and category path. 10 results per page.
tools.name: yahoo_chiebukuro_search

tools.description: Get Yahoo! JAPAN autocomplete suggestions for a partial query. Useful for discovering how Japanese users actually phrase a topic before running a full search.
tools.name: yahoo_suggest_keywords

tools.description: List the Yahoo! JAPAN search verticals this server exposes, with the tool name and paging behaviour of each. Call this to decide which search tool fits a question.
tools.name: yahoo_list_verticals

tools.description: Search the Microsoft Bing web index via Bing's native v7 search API (the endpoint embedded in the Bing app). Returns title, direct destination URL, the displayed URL and a snippet, plus the reported total hit count and related queries. 10 results per page.
tools.name: bing_web_search

tools.description: Search Bing images. Returns the original image URL, a Bing thumbnail, the page the image appears on and a title. Fetched the way the Bing app receives it (mobile user agent + app-style parameters), the only form where Bing server-renders image results. 12 results per page; this form has no total count.
tools.name: bing_image_search

tools.description: Search Bing videos across YouTube, TikTok, Niconico and other hosts. Returns title, the real watch URL (taken from the result link's churl parameter), hosting site, channel, duration, view count and upload date text.
tools.name: bing_video_search

tools.description: Search Bing News for news articles. Returns headline, article URL, publisher, publish-time text and a snippet. Bing's news page does not paginate, so this returns the first page only.
tools.name: bing_news_search

tools.description: Get Bing autocomplete suggestions for a partial query (the Bing app's own suggestions API). Useful for discovering how people phrase a topic before running a full search. Pass vertical "images" or "videos" for candidates in those verticals; mkt/setlang select the market the app would request for (the app derives them from the device locale).
tools.name: bing_suggest

tools.description: Search Bing Shopping (the shop vertical the Bing app renders). Returns offer cards with title, price text, seller, rating, image and the product URL.
tools.name: bing_shopping_search

tools.description: Fetch Bing's current trending topics (the same feed the app shows). Takes no query; limit caps the topics returned. Note: on current server behaviour this endpoint answers anonymous requests with HTTP 401, which is reported as a structured error.
tools.name: bing_trending_topics

tools.description: Run Bing Visual Search over an image, the way the Bing app's camera search does: pass the image bytes base64-encoded. Returns identification tags with the actions (pages including the image, similar images, related searches) the service attaches. Note: on current server behaviour this endpoint answers anonymous requests with HTTP 401, which is reported as a structured error.
tools.name: bing_visual_search

tools.description: Build the Bing search URL for a query and vertical (web, image, video, news) without performing any search. Works offline.
tools.name: bing_build_search_url

tools.description: List the Bing search verticals this server exposes, with the tool name for each. Call this to decide which search tool fits a question.
tools.name: bing_list_verticals

tools.description: Run a Naver integrated search and get the subject sections (news, images, blog, dictionary, web documents, ...) in page order, each with its own results. Best first tool when the right vertical is unclear, or for a broad overview of a Korean topic.
tools.name: naver_search

tools.description: Search Naver's web-results view (external web documents). Returns title, URL, snippet and Naver's rank. The tab serves one top-selection batch, so only page 1 exists — asking for page 2 returns an explicit error rather than a repeat of page 1.
tools.name: naver_web_search

tools.description: Search Naver images. Returns the original image URL (recovered from behind Naver's thumbnail proxy), a thumbnail, the source page, the source label and pixel dimensions. Pages follow the more-API chain the page itself issues (up to page 10).
tools.name: naver_image_search

tools.description: Search Naver News for Korean news articles. Returns headline, article URL, publisher, relative publish time, snippet and thumbnail. Pages follow the more-API chain the page itself issues (up to page 10).
tools.name: naver_news_search

tools.description: Search Naver videos across YouTube and other hosts. Returns title, watch URL, hosting platform, channel, duration, relative upload time, view count and thumbnail. Pages follow the more-API chain the page itself issues (up to page 10).
tools.name: naver_video_search

tools.description: Search Naver Blog posts. Returns title, post URL, blog name and id, relative publish time, snippet and thumbnail. Pages follow the more-API chain the page itself issues (up to page 10).
tools.name: naver_blog_search

tools.description: Search the Naver Cafe tab (community posts). Returns title, post URL, cafe name, relative publish time and snippet. Only the first page exists as a server-rendered page (the app's continuation is a native API this build does not reproduce), so page > 1 is an explicit error.
tools.name: naver_cafe_search

tools.description: Search the Naver 지식iN (knowledge Q&A) tab. Returns question title, URL, relative publish time, snippet, answer count, category and the status badge (e.g. 답변완료). Only the first page exists as a server-rendered page, so page > 1 is an explicit error.
tools.name: naver_kin_search

tools.description: Get Naver autocomplete suggestions for a partial query. Useful for discovering how Korean users actually phrase a topic before running a full search.
tools.name: naver_suggest

tools.description: Build the Naver search URL for a query and vertical (integrated, web, image, news, video, blog) exactly as the client fetches it — no network access. Useful for handing a human a link to open.
tools.name: naver_build_search_url

tools.description: List the Naver search verticals this server exposes, with the tool name and paging behaviour of each, plus the tabs that exist but are not supported. Call this to decide which search tool fits a question.
tools.name: naver_list_verticals

tools.description: Search the Yahoo (US) web index. Returns title, real destination URL (Yahoo redirect links are unwrapped), snippet and source site. 7 results per page. Note: this is Yahoo US (search.yahoo.com), not Yahoo! JAPAN.
tools.name: yahoo_us_web_search

tools.description: Search Yahoo (US) videos across YouTube and other hosts. Returns title, watch URL, duration, source site, description and thumbnail. 60 results per page.
tools.name: yahoo_us_video_search

tools.description: Search Yahoo (US) images. Returns title, the page the image appears on, the original image URL, a thumbnail, dimensions and the source site. 60 results per page. Pages are fetched by the bundled helper process with a browser-grade client because Yahoo's image host refuses plain HTTP requests. The optional filters are the image SERP's own filter parameters; related queries found on the page are returned as related_queries.
tools.name: yahoo_us_image_search

tools.description: Search Yahoo (US) news articles. Returns headline, article URL, publisher, relative publish time and a snippet. 10 results per page.
tools.name: yahoo_us_news_search

tools.description: Get Yahoo (US) autocomplete suggestions for a partial query. Useful for discovering how users actually phrase a topic before running a full search.
tools.name: yahoo_us_suggest

tools.description: Build the Yahoo (US) search URL for a query and vertical (web, image, video, news, suggest) without performing any search. Useful for handing a user a link to open themselves.
tools.name: yahoo_us_build_search_url

tools.description: List the Yahoo (US) search verticals this server exposes, with the tool name and paging behaviour of each. Call this to decide which search tool fits a question.
tools.name: yahoo_us_list_verticals

tools.description: Search the Yandex web index. Best general-purpose tool for finding Russian-language web pages, shops, official sites and documentation. Returns title, destination URL, displayed path and snippet. About 10 organic results per page; page is 1-based (the session flow is verified live for the first two pages). With include_special_cards the result also carries the page's non-organic cards (AI answer, ad blocks, related searches) under special_cards.
tools.name: yandex_web_search

tools.description: Search Yandex images. Returns the original image URL, a Yandex thumbnail, pixel dimensions and the source page each image appears on. 20 results per page; page is 1-based.
tools.name: yandex_image_search

tools.description: Search Yandex videos across VK, YouTube, RuTube, OK and other hosts. Returns title, the watch URL on the hosting service, duration, provider and publish date.
tools.name: yandex_video_search

tools.description: Get Yandex autocomplete suggestions for a partial query. Useful for discovering how Russian users actually phrase a topic before running a full search.
tools.name: yandex_suggest

tools.description: Get Yandex query-ending suggestions: the completions the search box offers for how a query could end (the suggest service's endings mode), as opposed to yandex_suggest's whole-query completions.
tools.name: yandex_suggest_endings

tools.description: Build the Yandex search URL for a query and vertical (web, image, video, suggest) without performing a search. Useful for handing a link to the user. News has no URL builder: it moved to dzen.ru and requires Yandex SSO.
tools.name: yandex_build_search_url

tools.description: List the Yandex search verticals this server exposes, with the tool name and paging behaviour of each. News is listed as unsupported, with the reason. Call this to decide which search tool fits a question.
tools.name: yandex_list_verticals

tools.description: Search AliExpress products through the APK-derived direct MTop search endpoint.
tools.name: aliexpress_search_products

tools.description: Fetch normalized AliExpress product details by product id or product URL.
tools.name: aliexpress_get_product

tools.description: Get AliExpress keyword suggestions through the recommend MTop endpoint (measured working; the APK suggestion API cannot be invoked through the H5 gateway).
tools.name: aliexpress_suggest_keywords

tools.description: Fetch AliExpress product reviews through the APK-derived MTop review endpoint.
tools.name: aliexpress_get_reviews

tools.description: Query one SKU of an AliExpress product (mtop.aliexpress.pdp.sku.query): price/stock for the selected SKU. Live-verified anonymously. The response data shape is not fully documented, so the raw data is returned alongside any extracted sku_combinations.
tools.name: aliexpress_query_sku

tools.description: Adjust the selected SKU of an AliExpress product (mtop.aliexpress.pdp.sku.adjust). Request shape is implemented from the app-derived builder, but this endpoint has NOT been live-verified yet (results carry live_verified: false).
tools.name: aliexpress_adjust_sku

tools.description: Adjust the PDP main block for a selected SKU (mtop.aliexpress.pdp.main.adjust). Request shape is implemented from the app-derived builder, but this endpoint has NOT been live-verified yet (results carry live_verified: false).
tools.name: aliexpress_adjust_pdp

tools.description: Fetch an AliExpress store's product groups (mtop.ae.shop.search.product.groupType). Request shape is implemented from the app-derived builder; live acceptance is not yet confirmed (results carry live_verified: false).
tools.name: aliexpress_get_store_groups

tools.description: Fetch an AliExpress store page module (ModuleAsyncService). Request shape is implemented from the app-derived builder; live acceptance is not yet confirmed (results carry live_verified: false).
tools.name: aliexpress_get_store_module

tools.description: Search products in an AliExpress store through the captured Android store MTop endpoint. seller_id is required (measured: omitting it fails with FAIL_SYS_BIZPARAM_MISSED).
tools.name: aliexpress_search_store_products

tools.description: Search Goofish (Xianyu) products through the APK-derived MTOP search endpoint. Requests are signed by the SecurityGuard runtime bundled with the server; the device identity is generated by the server itself. No configuration is required: on first use the server downloads the Goofish app package (~269 MB, SHA-256 verified) and assembles the runtime in its data directory. The signing harness boots in the background when the server starts; a Goofish call made before the boot finishes waits for it (the boot takes several minutes). Sorted or filtered search may be rejected by the server (HTTP 419; cause undetermined). The optional filter arguments (prop_selections = CPV property selections as {property_id: [value_id, ...]}, price_range in "min,max" form, province/city/area, category ids) switch the call to the full filter form.
tools.name: goofish_search_products

tools.description: Fetch normalized Goofish (Xianyu) product details by item id or product URL.
tools.name: goofish_get_product

tools.description: Get Goofish (Xianyu) keyword suggestions through the APK-derived MTOP suggest endpoint.
tools.name: goofish_suggest_keywords

tools.description: Fetch public comments for a Goofish (Xianyu) product through the APK-derived MTOP comment endpoint. The app's comment.list has no page or cursor mechanism — rows_per_page is the only control; the response's next_page field is informational only and cannot be used to fetch further comments.
tools.name: goofish_get_comments

tools.description: Fetch recommended items related to a Goofish (Xianyu) product through the APK-derived MTOP recommend endpoint. Continuation is caller-carried: pass the previous result's next_page_state back as page_state to fetch the next page; every result carries the advanced next_page_state and has_more.
tools.name: goofish_get_recommendations

tools.description: Fetch the Goofish (Xianyu) home feed through the APK-derived MTOP home endpoint. Continuation is caller-carried: pass the previous result's next_page_state back as page_state (it takes precedence over page); results fetched through the state flow carry the advanced next_page_state.
tools.name: goofish_home_feed

tools.description: Fetch items similar to a Goofish (Xianyu) product (search.spusimilar.itemlist). conditions is the caller-supplied conditions object (in the app it is built from the search response's server-issued spuId; the detail response carries no spu identifier). Continuation: pass page_no from the previous result's next_page_state. NOT live-verified: the one measured attempt was rejected by the server-side app-version gate FAIL_BIZ_SERVER_NEED_UPGRADE_MSG2, so a live call may return that business error instead of data.
tools.name: goofish_get_similar_items

tools.description: Fetch a Goofish (Xianyu) category guide tree through the APK-derived MTOP category endpoint. name optionally selects a guide by name.
tools.name: goofish_get_category_guide

tools.description: Fetch the seller evaluations (rate list) for one Goofish (Xianyu) item through the APK-derived MTOP rate endpoint. rated_uid is the rated seller's user id.
tools.name: goofish_get_rate_list

tools.description: Fetch a Goofish (Xianyu) user's header info through the APK-derived MTOP headinfo endpoint. NOT live-verified: the request shape is fixed by the app's typed classes, but no in-app caller was found, so reachability is unconfirmed.
tools.name: goofish_get_user_headinfo

tools.description: Fetch Goofish (Xianyu) publish.items. NOTE: the endpoint has no parameter identifying another user — its confirmed use is selecting one's own items; this is NOT another seller's public listing.
tools.name: goofish_get_seller_items

tools.description: Fetch the Goofish (Xianyu) same-city feed (local.home / local.home.feeds). data_source_id and version are caller-supplied (they are delivered to the app by its page configuration). feeds_api=true selects the feeds variant, which is NOT live-verified.
tools.name: goofish_get_city_feed

tools.description: Fetch Goofish (Xianyu) nearby corner info (local.near.by.corner.info). NOT live-verified. Coordinates are caller-supplied strings, never invented.
tools.name: goofish_get_city_nearby

tools.description: List Goofish (Xianyu) fishponds (鱼塘). NOT live-verified (the gateway registration record notes this API may not be registered).
tools.name: goofish_get_fishpond_list

tools.description: Fetch one Goofish (Xianyu) fishpond's detail (fishpool.id). NOT live-verified.
tools.name: goofish_get_fishpond_info

tools.description: Fetch a Goofish (Xianyu) fishpond's public posts/comments (fishpool.comment.list). NOT live-verified. Coordinates are caller-supplied and omitted when absent.
tools.name: goofish_get_fishpond_comments

tools.description: Fetch Goofish (Xianyu) video play info (video.play) for a video id. NOT live-verified.
tools.name: goofish_get_video_play

tools.description: Fetch Goofish (Xianyu) video play info from a normalized feed card (a card object as returned by the feed/search parsers, carrying video_id/has_video). Cards without a confirmed video, or with a mismatched item_id, are refused before sending. NOT live-verified.
tools.name: goofish_get_video_play_from_feed_card

tools.description: Fetch Goofish (Xianyu) fun/explore comments (fun.general.comment.list). Cursor paging: pass the previous response's last_cursor as begin_cursor. NOT live-verified.
tools.name: goofish_get_fun_comments

tools.description: Search Mercari Japan products through the public web Connect-RPC JSON endpoint. Login-free: requests are authorized with a locally generated DPoP proof, no account or token needed. Each item carries is_auction and, for auction listings, an auction object (highest_bid is the current bid, not a buy-now price; also initial_price, total_bids, bid_deadline). Set exclude_auction to drop auction listings from the results.
tools.name: mercari_search_products

tools.description: Fetch normalized Mercari item detail by item id or item URL through the APK-derived JSON endpoint. The item carries is_auction and, for auction listings, an auction object (highest_bid, initial_price, total_bids, expected_end_time, state).
tools.name: mercari_get_product

tools.description: List a seller's Mercari items through the APK-derived items/get_items JSON endpoint. Items carry is_auction and an auction object for auction listings.
tools.name: mercari_search_seller_products

tools.description: Fetch Mercari autocomplete keyword/seller suggestions through the APK-derived BFF endpoint.
tools.name: mercari_suggest_keywords

tools.description: Search Mercari brand IDs for use with mercari_search_products brand_ids.
tools.name: mercari_search_brands

tools.description: Search Mercari category IDs for use with mercari_search_products category_ids.
tools.name: mercari_search_categories

tools.description: Get seller reviews/ratings for a Mercari seller. Returns rating summary (good/normal/bad counts, star rating) and individual review messages. Note: the endpoint ignores pagination (verified live — page 2 returns page 1), so page > 1 is rejected with an explicit error rather than silently repeating the first page; the real continuation mechanism is undetermined.
tools.name: mercari_get_reviews

tools.description: Search Yahoo Flea Market (Yahoo!フリマ / PayPayフリマ) products. Uses anonymous __NEXT_DATA__ SSR from paypayfleamarket.yahoo.co.jp. No login needed.
tools.name: yflea_search_products

tools.description: Fetch Yahoo Flea Market item detail by item ID or URL. Returns full item data. Uses anonymous __NEXT_DATA__ SSR, no login needed.
tools.name: yflea_get_product

tools.description: Get seller reviews/ratings for a Yahoo Flea Market seller. Returns rating summary and individual reviews. No login needed.
tools.name: yflea_get_reviews

tools.description: Search Rakuten Rakuma (楽天ラクマ) products through fril.jp. Uses anonymous Rakuten Analytics data. No login needed. 40 items/page.
tools.name: rakuma_search_products

tools.description: Fetch Rakuma item detail by item hash or URL. Returns item data from schema.org JSON-LD Product structured data including seller_hash for use with rakuma_get_reviews. No login needed.
tools.name: rakuma_get_product

tools.description: Get seller reviews/ratings for a Rakuma seller. Returns aggregate rating and individual reviews. The seller_hash (32-char hex) is available from rakuma_get_product item detail (seller.seller_hash field). Reviews are sliced client-side from the shop page's full review list, so page/limit page through that list.
tools.name: rakuma_get_reviews

tools.description: Search Yahoo Auctions Japan (ヤフオク) products via the official app API (anonymous, appid). Supports open and closed (落札済み) auctions. sort vocabulary: price_asc | price_desc | bids | bids_asc | end_time | end_time_desc | newest | total_price_asc | total_price_desc | watch_count | featured | start_price_asc | start_price_desc; literal API values (e.g. +TOTAL_PRICE) are also accepted for the matching status. seller_type is a comma-joined list of AUC_STORE / AUCTION / FLEAMARKET; prefecture_code takes comma-joined Prefecture values (e.g. TOKYO,OSAKA). conditions (raw ItemCondition ids, comma-joined) takes precedence over condition, and submit_type (ALL / AUCTION / FIXED) over buynow_only.
tools.name: yauction_search_products

tools.description: Fetch Yahoo Auctions Japan item detail by auction ID or item URL via the official app API (anonymous, appid), no login needed.
tools.name: yauction_get_product

tools.description: Get closed-auction price statistics for a Yahoo Auctions Japan catalog id (search/items/statistics, hm1 variant): totals, the last closed item, and per-day count/avg/max/min. conditions takes ItemCondition ids (a single value is recommended until the multi-value joining form is live-confirmed).
tools.name: yauction_get_statistics

tools.description: Get closed-auction price statistics (yne variant, itemState=closed fixed) with the additional shp_spec / seller_type filters. Same result shape as yauction_get_statistics.
tools.name: yauction_get_statistics_closed

tools.description: Get a Yahoo Auctions Japan seller's profile (user/v2 profile): display name, icon, store flags, eKYC/speed-shipping flags and the ratings summary.
tools.name: yauction_get_seller_profile

tools.description: Get a Yahoo Auctions Japan store seller's store profile (user/v1 store-profile): announcement text and banners. Non-store sellers may legitimately error here.
tools.name: yauction_get_store_profile

tools.description: Get seller reviews/ratings for a Yahoo Auctions Japan seller. Returns individual reviews parsed from the seller rating page plus a ratings_summary (enriched from the seller profile API when available).
tools.name: yauction_get_reviews

tools.description: Get Yahoo Auctions Japan keyword suggestions (with category candidates) via the official app API (anonymous, appid).
tools.name: yauction_suggest_keywords

tools.description: Search Rakuten Ichiba products through the Rakuten app's guest BFF (dynamic/search/v1). No login or API key. Result product_id is "{shop_id}_{item_id}" and feeds rakuten_get_product / rakuten_get_reviews. sort is one of the app's sorts: the standard form (relevancy, price_low_to_high_all, price_high_to_low_all, newest, review_count_all, review_score_all, price_plus_shippingfee_low_to_high_all, price_plus_shippingfee_high_to_low_all) or the highRelevancy form without the _all suffix (price_low_to_high, price_high_to_low, review_count, review_score, and the two shipping-inclusive forms); the value passes through to the BFF.
tools.name: rakuten_search_products

tools.description: Fetch Rakuten Ichiba product detail through the app's guest BFF (itemscreen/get/v16). Identify the item by shop_id+item_id (or the search result's product "{shop_id}_{item_id}"), or by item_code, shop_id+manage_number, or item_url. The endpoint answers HTTP 207 for partial success; the tool reports ok from the core item data.
tools.name: rakuten_get_product

tools.description: Fetch Rakuten Ichiba product reviews through the app's guest BFF (review/list/v3). sort: -regtime (newest) | -evaluation | -judgment. sex: 0 = male, 1 = female. hits is capped at 30 by the server.
tools.name: rakuten_get_reviews

tools.description: Get Rakuten Ichiba keyword suggestions through the app's guest BFF (search/suggest): keyword completions and genre candidates for a partial keyword. No login.
tools.name: rakuten_suggest_keywords

tools.description: Search Rakuten Ichiba in the app's product-aggregated form (product/search/v1): results are grouped by product rather than by shop listing. No login.
tools.name: rakuten_search_products_aggregated

tools.description: Fetch a Rakuten Ichiba genre subtree (genre/search/v1): the genre itself plus, per the include flags, its children, siblings, tag groups and tags. No login.
tools.name: rakuten_get_genre_tree

tools.description: Fetch per-variant details for a Rakuten Ichiba item (variantdetails/get/v5): price, inventory and delivery captions for one variant. The state parameters (variant_id, is_available_for_sale, prices, inventory, is_subscription_eligible, delivery_caption_variant) are carried over from rakuten_get_product's response (its variants entries) — pass them from there. No login.
tools.name: rakuten_get_variant_details

tools.description: Search Qoo10 Japan products through the Qoo10 app's mobile API (GetMoveSearchData). No login. sort: 0 ranking, 1 best-selling, 2 newest, 3 price ascending, 4 price descending, 5 review score, 6 review count. Brand / shipping-from / color / attribute codes come from the service's filter info. Note: the app user agent carries a device-derived token that cannot be reproduced off-device; this client sends a format-preserving placeholder token in its place, which the service accepted in live verification. The service requires Japan-side access in practice.
tools.name: qoo10_search_products

tools.description: Fetch Qoo10 Japan product detail by GD_NO (goods code) or product URL. Qoo10 has no native detail API; this reproduces the app's WebView product page request and extracts the title, price and images from the returned page. Requires Japan-side access in practice (see qoo10_search_products).
tools.name: qoo10_get_product

tools.description: Get the Qoo10 Japan search filter information for a keyword (GetMoveSearchFilterInfo — the data the app's filter popup is built from): the brand, colour, price-band, category, shipping-from, review-score and attribute codes that qoo10_search_products accepts as filter values in this keyword's context. Optionally pass the category code or already-selected brand codes to scope the context. No login. Requires Japan-side access in practice (see qoo10_search_products).
tools.name: qoo10_get_search_filters

tools.description: Get Qoo10 Japan keyword suggestions through the Qoo10 app's mobile API (GetMoveAutoKeywordSearch). No login. Requires Japan-side access in practice (see qoo10_search_products).
tools.name: qoo10_suggest_keywords

tools.description: Search Yahoo! Shopping Japan products through the Yahoo! Shopping app's native API (searchList/v4). No login; the app's built-in appid is used. order is one of: Recommend, Price, TotalPrice, ReviewCount, ReviewScoreAverage, DiscountRate, CatalogReleaseDate, RegistrationDate, GoodDelivery (asc applies mainly to Price / TotalPrice). Result product_id is "{storeId}_{itemCode}" and feeds yshopping_get_product and yshopping_get_reviews.
tools.name: yshopping_search_products

tools.description: Fetch Yahoo! Shopping Japan product detail through the app's native API (item-detail/app/v2). product is the search result's product_id ("{storeId}_{itemCode}") or a store product URL. Detail images are returned as image_ids (the API hands out ids, not URLs); the main image URL is in image.
tools.name: yshopping_get_product

tools.description: Fetch Yahoo! Shopping Japan product reviews. The app's native API has no review-list endpoint; the app itself shows reviews by opening the review page (shopping.yahoo.co.jp/review/item/list) in a WebView, and this tool reads reviews from that page's server-rendered data and, for anything beyond the first 20, a non-default sort, or a filter, from the continuation endpoint the page's own SPA uses. product is the search result's product_id ("{storeId}_{itemCode}") or a store product URL. offset is the zero-based index of the first review to return (page through results with offset + count, or the returned next_offset). sort is one of the page's own sort orders: lengthDesc (default, おすすめ順), ratingDesc (評価の高い順), referenceCountDesc (いいねの多い順), postedTimeDesc (新着順), pickUp. rating and sub_review_id apply the page's own review filters (both live-verified). Returns the rating summary (total, average, per-star counts), the reviews, next_offset, and subReviewSummaries — the item's aspect summaries whose id values are what sub_review_id takes.
tools.name: yshopping_get_reviews

tools.description: Get Yahoo! Shopping Japan keyword suggestions through the suggest endpoint the app uses (suggest-shop.yahooapis.jp, appid built in). Returns keyword completions plus, with detailed (default), category candidates and direct store links. No login.
tools.name: yshopping_suggest_keywords

tools.description: Search Amazon.co.jp products by reproducing the Amazon Shopping app's WebView requests (app-format user agent and the app's pre-navigation cookies; no browser engine). sort (the web s parameter): relevancerank, price-asc-rank, price-desc-rank, review-rank, date-desc-rank. Refinements use Amazon's web facet vocabulary, passed through as the app does: department (i:), category_node (n:), price band (p_36), prime_only (p_85), in_stock_only, min_rating (p_72), brand (p_89), seller_id (me), plus raw rh entries. Note: Amazon serves these pages only to Japan-side access in practice.
tools.name: amazon_search_products

tools.description: Fetch Amazon.co.jp product detail by ASIN or product URL, reproducing the app's WebView request (see amazon_search_products). Extracts title, price, main image, rating and review count from the product page. Requires Japan-side access in practice.
tools.name: amazon_get_product

tools.description: Get Amazon.co.jp keyword suggestions through the completion endpoint the Amazon Shopping app uses. No login. Requires Japan-side access in practice (see amazon_search_products). Note: Amazon product reviews are not exposed — the review pages sit behind a sign-in wall (verified), so no review tool exists.
tools.name: amazon_suggest_keywords

tools.description: List APK-derived endpoints and runtime data sources currently supported by Shopping_MCP.
tools.name: shopping_list_sources

tools.description: Search YouTube through the YouTube Android app's own InnerTube API (guest session, no login). `items` holds the video results (id, title, watch URL, channel, view count, duration); `results` holds every result kind in page order — videos, Shorts, playlists and channels — each tagged with its kind. Also returns the estimated total and a continuation token. Pass `continuation` (from a previous call) to fetch the next page; filters and sort are the app's own search parameters.
tools.name: youtube_search_videos

tools.description: Get one YouTube video's details through the app's InnerTube API: title, channel, length, view count, description, keywords, thumbnail, caption tracks. The like count is merged from the watch-next response and the exact view count plus the relative upload time (upload_time_text, e.g. "5y ago") from updated_metadata — the same entities the app renders. No response in the app's flow carries an absolute calendar publish date, so published_date stays null.
tools.name: youtube_get_video

tools.description: Get the related videos shown next to a YouTube video (the app's watch-next list, about 20 entries with title, channel, view count and duration), the watched video's like count, and the continuation tokens: related_continuation pages this list (pass it back as `continuation`), comments_continuation opens the comments section — pass it to youtube_get_comments.
tools.name: youtube_get_related

tools.description: Get a YouTube video's caption transcript through the app's own two-step caption flow (player-issued track URL, then the timedtext document). Returns the cues with timestamps plus the joined text. `language` selects a track by language code; without it a manual track is preferred over the automatic (ASR) one.
tools.name: youtube_get_captions

tools.description: Get one page of a YouTube video's comments (about 20, with author, text, like count text and reply count) through the app's InnerTube next API. The first page's token comes from youtube_get_related (`comments_continuation`); the result's `next_continuation` fetches the following page.
tools.name: youtube_get_comments

tools.description: Get one Bilibili video's details through the app's viewunite View call, as a guest — no login. Identify the video by BV id / video URL (video_id) or by numeric aid. Returns title, author, cover, description, duration, play/danmaku/like/coin/favorite/share counts, publish time and the part (分P) list.
tools.name: bilibili_get_video

tools.description: Get the related videos Bilibili shows next to a video (viewunite RelatesFeed), as a guest — no login. Identify the video by BV id / video URL (video_id) or by numeric aid. `next` continues the feed.
tools.name: bilibili_get_related

tools.description: Search Bilibili videos through the Bilibili Android app's own gRPC search (SearchAll), as a guest — no login. Returns title, BV id, author, cover, duration, play and danmaku counts and the watch URL, plus a `next` token for paging.
tools.name: bilibili_search_videos

tools.description: Search CSDN through the CSDN app's own gateway API (the same assembled search the Android app uses, with its search categories). Returns titles, authors, digests, URLs and view counts. Works without login. There is no forum category: the app has no forum search (verified in the current app), so forum/bbs is rejected. The ebook category exists in the app but the server currently returns it empty. search_user_name switches to the app's personal-home search (only for categories all/blog/ask/download/vip, as in the app).
tools.name: csdn_search_articles

tools.description: Fetch a CSDN blog article (title, author, full body HTML and text, tags, counts) through the CSDN app's BlogPhoenix API. Works without login.
tools.name: csdn_get_article

tools.description: List the ZeroSearch engine categories (web / shopping / media / articles), the engines in each category, and the MCP tools that belong to each engine. Takes no arguments.
tools.name: zero_list_categories
